PROMOTED 2026-07-29 on candidate rebind. All nine parity-*.test.ts suites run against both backends through the portable createServer at this candidate: native 67 pass/0 fail/0 skip, wasm 64 pass/0 fail/3 skip. This replaces the session-map smoke that backed the old cb0cb698 evidence and that was demoted for not supporting a parity claim. The three wasm skips are pre-existing native-only compat checks; the remaining in-test guards are enumerated in the evidence artifact. caPem CA-root trust is end-to-end verified in the same tree by wasm-ca-trust.test.ts, which handshakes and echoes stream data between a server holding a CA-issued leaf and a client trusting only that CA and refuses a foreign CA with E_TLS alert 48 (unknown_ca); the QUIC-layer equivalent is spike_tests::loopback_handshake_over_ca_root_trust. cert::generate_ca_signed is gated behind dev-insecure so shipped artifacts cannot mint a CA.

scopeLimits.summary: Hosted wasm Bun suite evidence is produced on the ubuntu wasm CI job; local darwin evidence is additionally bound under docs/release-evidence/ while Actions are unavailable, and does not expand the claimed support matrix.

docs/release-evidence/ directories other than the current candidate are named after commits that existed before the branch commit messages were aligned to the project format. Those SHAs no longer resolve in history; the artifacts are retained as a record of the runs, and no claim references them.
